items.code:
import bpy

lamp = bpy.data.objects['Lamp']
lamp.data.energy = 60.0
lamp.data.color = (1.0, 0.82, 0.62)

wood = bpy.data.materials.new('Desk Wood')
wood.use_nodes = True
bsdf = wood.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0.35, 0.2, 0.1, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.6
for name in ('Desk Top', 'Leg.001', 'Leg.002', 'Leg.003', 'Leg.004'):
    bpy.data.objects[name].data.materials.append(wood)
